seo_title: Cave Creek and Carefree Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Cave Creek and Carefree, AZ: the Frontier Town tree lighting, Carefree Lights Up and Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids.
lede: Cave Creek and neighboring Carefree celebrate Christmas with small-town tree lightings, Santa photos and a Kiwanis party that gives away bikes to local kids.
celebrates: The Town of Cave Creek and Frontier Town light the season cowboy style with a tree lighting on the Friday after Thanksgiving, with Santa photos, carolers, a message from the mayor and hot cocoa from Big Earl's. The next day, neighboring Carefree gathers around a 20 foot tree at the Carefree Desert Gardens for Carefree Lights Up, followed by a concert of local performers. The Kiwanis Club of Carefree holds Christmas for the Kids downtown, with Santa and Mrs. Claus, a camel and her baby, ponies, hayrides and free hot dogs and cotton candy for every family.
lastyear: Cave Creek has no last year to report for its tree lighting. Visit Cave Creek calls the 2026 Frontier Town event the very first annual tree lighting. In Carefree, the Kiwanis club's most recent write-up that we found is from December 2, 2023, when the club gave away 60 new bikes at its Christmas for the Kids event at the Sanderson Lincoln Pavilion, 10 bikes each hour to kids in three age groups.
facts: The Carefree Desert Gardens, where the town tree is lit, started out as a dirt parking lot and was transformed in 2001 into a garden with walkways, bridges and water features, according to the Arizona Memory Project. The Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids event is one of the Kiwanis Club of Carefree's signature events and is run with help from local high school students. The 2026 Cave Creek tree lighting includes a live nativity and hayrides, according to Visit Cave Creek.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Cave Creek or Carefree this season. Families who want a train usually drive to McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale, which runs Holiday Lights with train rides in the evening, from 5:30 to 9:30 pm on the host's calendar and listed on our Scottsdale guide. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler is a railway museum with its own listing on our museums guide. Check each host for current ride days and prices.

traditions: The Town of Cave Creek and Frontier Town hold a cowboy style tree lighting with Santa photos, carolers and hot cocoa.
The Town of Carefree lights its 20 foot Christmas tree at the Desert Gardens with bell ringers, carols and a concert.
The Kiwanis Club of Carefree hosts a free day of Santa, animals, hayrides and hourly bike giveaways.
Visit Cave Creek lists a live nativity at the Frontier Town tree lighting.
Carefree's concert features local dance groups, young vocalists and a children's choir.
kidfact: At Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids in Carefree, kids can have a photo taken with a camel and her baby, and the club raffles more than 50 new bikes.
faq: How does Cave Creek celebrate Christmas?

The Town of Cave Creek and Frontier Town hold a cowboy style tree lighting at Frontier Town, 6245 E Cave Creek Road. The schedule includes photos with Santa, Christmas melodies by Jubilate and King's Carolers, a message from the mayor and a countdown to the lit tree, with hot cocoa provided by Big Earl's. The town lists it as free.
Is Carefree part of this guide?

Yes. Carefree is a small neighboring town, so we fold its verified Christmas events into the Cave Creek guide. Carefree Lights Up at the Carefree Desert Gardens and the Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids event in downtown Carefree are both listed here, with their addresses and hosts on each card.
Is there a free event with Santa near Cave Creek?

Yes. The Cave Creek tree lighting has photos with Santa, and the Kiwanis Club of Carefree says Santa and Mrs. Claus attend its Christmas for the Kids event. Both are listed as free by their hosts. Each event listing on this page shows the date, time and address, so check the card before you drive.
What is Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids?

It is a free community event run by the Kiwanis Club of Carefree, one of its signature events. It features Santa and Mrs. Claus, a camel and her baby, live animals, miniature ponies, hayrides, free food, face painting and hourly bicycle giveaways, with more than 50 new bikes raffled. Winners must be present to claim a bike.
Is there a train ride in Cave Creek or Carefree?

We did not find a train ride in either town this season. Families usually drive to McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale, which has Holiday Lights with train rides in the evening, or visit the Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler. Check each host for current days and prices, since schedules and ticket rules can change.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Cave Creek and Carefree for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, all 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Cave Creek Tree Lighting at Frontier Town) through November 28, with Carefree Lights Up at the Desert Gardens and Kiwanis Christmas for the Kids in downtown Carefree both on Saturday, November 28. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
